home.title: Stay with the game.
home.description: Real-time volleyball scouting and video transport powered by high-precision controller input.
home.ready_description: Set the teams, connect a controller, and start recording from the first rally.
home.new_match_description: Set up teams and begin a live scouting session.
home.review_description: Browse recorded events and export match data.
home.controller_connect_hint: Press any button on gamepad to connect
home.card_resume_desc: Return to active scouting court with real-time video transport
home.card_quick_desc: Jump directly into a match session with default team rosters

home.card_review_desc: Inspect recorded rallies, court heatmaps, and export scouting data

setup.description: Set the two sides, then confirm the controller gesture you will use during live scouting.
setup.match_details_hint: Name the sides as they appear on the scoreboard.
setup.roster_hint: You can skip this and add player details during review.
setup.controller_check_hint: Try the live scouting gesture once before the match.
setup.controller_connect_hint: USB or Bluetooth · Press any button after connecting
setup.controller_connect_instruction: Connect a controller to run this check. You can skip it and start scouting without one.
setup.controller_wait_instruction: Hold the face button to open the skill wheel, then select Attack with the left stick.
setup.controller_move_instruction: Keep the face button held and flick the left stick toward Attack.
setup.controller_release_instruction: Attack selected. Release the face button to finish the check.
setup.controller_passed: Controller check passed. You are ready to scout.
setup.controller_step_move_detail: the left stick right to Attack
setup.start_error: Could not start this match. Check local storage and try again.
setup.start_note: You can pause and adjust the controller at any time.
settings.description: Tune the scouting experience for your match day setup.
settings.match_behavior_hint: The current sport and scoring rules are selected for volleyball.
settings.auto_score_hint: Apply point impact for terminal volleyball results. You can adjust it in Review.
settings.feedback_hint: Optional confirmation cues during live scouting.
settings.haptics_hint: Subtle controller vibration for selection and confirmation.
settings.audio_hint: A quiet tone after an event is saved.
settings.local_storage: SP Stick MVP stores scouting data locally in this browser and on this device.
settings.export_hint: Download a JSON backup with saved matches, events, and bookmarks.
settings.clear_hint: Remove saved matches, events, and bookmarks from this device.
settings.confirm_copy: This permanently removes saved matches, recorded events, and bookmarks from this device.
settings.clear_done: Saved match data was removed from this device.
settings.clear_error: Could not clear local match data.
settings.save_error: Could not save this preference. Try again.
settings.version_note: Dark match mode · Volleyball · Stored on this device
review.description: Review the recorded actions, adjust event details, and export the match record.
review.empty_match: Events recorded for this match will appear here.
review.delete_confirm: Delete this event? This will update the match score history.
controller.description: Tune your controls, confirm every input, and keep your attention on the court.
controller.diagram_label: Interactive controller diagram. Select a control to inspect its mapping.
controller.left_stick_help: Calibrate raw axes and set a comfortable drift boundary.
controller.haptics_unavailable: This controller or browser does not report vibration support
controller.input_note: The controller diagram highlights physical button presses. Stick markers show raw movement and the normalized value used by scouting.
controller.profile_hint: Built-in profiles stay unchanged. Apply an edit to make a custom copy for this controller.
controller.rename_copy_hint: Rename, duplicate, or delete the active custom profile.
controller.binding_conflict: That button is already assigned. Choose Replace, Swap, or Cancel.
controller.listening: Press a new button on the controller…
controller.listen_timeout: Listening timed out. Select Change binding to try again.
controller.capture_success: Input captured. Apply changes to save the mapping.
controller.connect_to_capture: Connect a controller before capturing a button.
controller.move_stick: Move the stick decisively in any direction (more than 60%).
controller.axis_detected: Axis movement detected. Review the calibration, then apply changes.
controller.profile_save_error: Could not save profile changes. Resolve duplicate inputs and try again.
controller.profile_create_error: Could not create a profile. Check that each captured input is unique.
controller.profile_created: Custom profile saved and activated. Calibrate the sticks before scouting.
controller.wizard_duplicate: That button was already captured. Release it, then capture a different control.
controller.wizard_intro: Capture each physical control in order. Release each one before the next step.
controller.export_error: Only valid custom profiles can be exported.
controller.import_error: This profile file is invalid or uses conflicting button assignments.
controller.delete_confirm_copy: This removes the saved custom profile from this device.
session.controller_navigation_hint: Use the left stick or D-pad to navigate. South selects, East goes back, and Menu resumes.
scout.quick_edit_hint: Choose a field, then use its face button to change it. Save or cancel when finished.
scout.quick_edit_error: Could not save the event. Your changes are still here; try again.
session.incomplete_warning: This rally is unfinished. Saved actions will remain marked incomplete and no point will be awarded. Continue?
scout.map_hint: Choose a zone to preview the action. Select a marker to inspect it.
scout.grid_hint: Hold X, move the left stick to a cell, then release. Center the stick to cancel, or tap a cell.
scout.pass_hint: Pass saves an action and continues the rally.
video.title: Match video
video.audioBlocked: Sound is unavailable. Continue scouting and try enabling it again.
video.empty: Add a video to capture match times with your events.
video.focus_empty: Add a video or continue scouting without one.
video.help: Press play when ready. Local files stay on this device; after reloading, your browser may ask you to select the file again.
video.invalidUrl: Enter a valid YouTube watch, short, live, or share URL.
video.wrongFile: Select the original file to keep saved event times linked. Use Choose local video to add a different file.
video.errors.localPermission: Allow access to this file, then retry or reselect it.
video.errors.localUnavailable: This local video is unavailable. Select it again to continue.
video.errors.localUnsupported: This video format could not be played. Select a supported video file.
video.errors.localTimeout: The video did not load. Retry or select it again.
video.errors.youtubeNetwork: Could not reach YouTube. Check your internet connection and retry.
video.errors.youtubeTimeout: YouTube did not respond. Retry the video.
video.errors.youtubeApi: YouTube's player could not start. Reload or try another video.
video.errors.youtubeUnavailable: This video cannot play here. Check its availability and sharing settings.
video.errors.youtubeEmbedding: The video owner does not allow embedding. Choose another video or a local file.
video.errors.youtubePlayback: YouTube could not start playback. Press play in the video controls.
video.errors.sourceMissing: This video source is not saved in the current match.
video.errors.sourceNotReady: Wait for the video to load, then select the event again.
video.errors.noEventSource: This event has no linked video time.

settings.audio_test_unavailable: Audio is unavailable in this browser.
